description: Retry batch photos that failed for a given reason, in two steps. First call with execute=false to get a preview: how many photos match, the estimated credit cost and a preview_id (valid 10 minutes, usable once). Show that to the user, then call again with execute=true and the preview_id. Requeued photos are charged when processed, usually 62 credits each; the preview's credits_per_photo and estimated_credits give the exact price.

created_after.description: Preview step: only batches created after this RFC 3339 time.

created_before.description: Preview step: only batches created before this RFC 3339 time.

execute.description: false = preview only; true = run a preview (needs preview_id).

preview_id.description: From the preview step; required when execute=true.

reason_code.description: Preview step: which failures to retry.

stagger_seconds.description: Preview step: spread the retries out.

name: requeue_failed_batch_photos
title: Retry failed batch photos
